title: U4 long silent side-loss online validation

method.gate: handover active and rear wall load already confirmed
method.result: side_load_lost_silent changes the state to S5

historical_replay.interpretation: Existing long silent-loss examples occur before rear confirmation and are not S6 truth windows. The rear gate prevents those examples from becoming false S5 or S6 decisions.

online_main_runner.runner_error: upper_B_rear_travel exceeded the existing left wrist safety envelope at 9.22 N and 0.311 Nm after U4 completion
online_main_runner.u4_result: U4 reached upper_slot_complete before the later Cube_11 stop

limitations: This online run validates that the observer is live and that the S6 rear-confirmed window remains stable. It does not provide a positive online silent-loss event because the physical trial did not create rear-confirmed sustained loss.
The historical silent-loss positives remain pre-rear-confirmation cases. A separate controlled perturbation is needed to create a rear-confirmed silent-loss positive.
The motion controller and safety envelope were not changed.
